  a name cannot contain a space: use letters, digits, dash or underscore

  own message, because "cannot contain" is nonsense about nothing.

  time when [38;5;153msend-keys -t 'a:0'[39m addresses window 0 of session [38;5;153ma[39m instead. That's why the guard exists.

  - [1mOn the session view, behind the tick Withdraw uses[0m [3m(recommended)[0m — one pattern for destructive 
    things, no script, and the page you're on is the page that ends it. Posts like the start form:

    reaching it is deliberate. Cost: two navigations at exactly the moment you want one, and a list 
    is where it's easiest to stop the wrong session.                                               
  - [1mLeave it on the command line[0m — cost is what you just asked about: away from a terminal, a      
    crashed or runaway session can't be ended, and Mustur restarts nothing by design.
